claims.text: The hotel is in the MNC Tower complex in Central Jakarta.

findings.quote: situated in Central Jakarta’s prestigious MNC Tower complex

claims.text: The hotel is minutes from the National Monument (Monas) and the Presidential Palace.

findings.quote: just minutes from National Monument (Monas) and the Presidential Palace

claims.text: Guest rooms are designed with Indonesian touches and materials.

findings.quote: guest rooms are designed with Indonesian touches and materials

claims.text: Rooms have a deep-soaking marble bath with custom Le Labo products.

findings.quote: Unwind in the deep-soaking marble bath with custom Le Labo® products

claims.text: Rooms have a desk made of Trembesi wood.

findings.quote: Desk made of Trembesi wood

claims.text: The Diplomat Suite includes a private gym and a kitchen.

findings.quote: This lavish and elegant suite offers 228 square meter space, equipped with one king bed, a living room, a private gym, a kitchen

claims.text: Li Lian serves Cantonese cuisine and has six private rooms.

findings.quote: Li Lián serves authentic Cantonese cuisine, highlighted by its signature wood-fired Peking Duck. With elegant interiors, curated Chinese teas, and six private rooms

claims.text: Li Lian Park Lounge is a celebration space for Cantonese dining, suited to Sangjit ceremonies and family celebrations.

findings.quote: LI LIAN 丽莲 Park Lounge is an elevated celebration space
it offers refined Cantonese cuisine in an intimate and elegant setting—ideal for Sangjit ceremonies, family celebrations, and private events.

claims.text: KITA Restaurant serves modern Japanese cuisine, including teppanyaki, shabu-shabu, robatayaki and sushi, from an open kitchen.

findings.quote: KITA 喜多 Restaurant offers the authentic flavors of modern Japanese cuisine ranging from Teppanyaki, Shabu-Shabu, Tempura, Robatayaki, Sushi and Sashimi, all served from a lively open kitchen.

claims.text: Dining Room, on level 22, serves buffets of Indonesian specialties alongside regional Italian cuisine.

findings.quote: Situated on level 22, Dining Room offers exquisite buffets showcasing authentic Indonesian specialties alongside regional Italian cuisine

claims.text: Atelier 23 is a culinary and patisserie space combining French classics with Southeast Asian signatures.

findings.quote: Atelier 23 is a contemporary culinary and pâtisserie space above the city, where French classics and elevated Southeast Asian signatures come together

claims.text: The Spa, on the 35th floor, draws on Indonesian healing traditions with aesthetic treatments and traditional body therapies.

findings.quote: Bringing Indonesian healing traditions to the 21st century, The Spa offers advanced aesthetic treatments and traditional body therapies to enhance your wellbeing.
Experience the breathtaking view from the 35th floor while rejuvenating and revitalizing yourself.

claims.text: Li Lian's signature Peking duck is slow-roasted over rambutan wood and carved at the table.

findings.quote: signature wood-fired Peking duck is slow-roasted over rambutan wood for tender meat, crispy skin and a rich, smoky aroma. Carved at your table

claims.text: KITA Bar is a rooftop bar on level 36 with outdoor and indoor spaces and sunset views of the National Monument (Monas).

findings.quote: Located on level 36, KITA Bar provides both outdoor and indoor spaces, as well as stunning sunset views of the Indonesia's National Monument (Monas) and Central Jakarta. Unwind to the beats at our rooftop bar

claims.text: The Magic Table is a dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, known as The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping on each table.

findings.quote: A spellbinding dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amélie van Tass, the internationally renowned duo known as The Clairvoyants. Using 3D projection mapping, each dining table becomes part of the story.

claims.text: All guest rooms are from the 25th floor upward, with views of Jakarta.

findings.quote: all offering uninterrupted views of Jakarta from the 25th floor onwards

claims.text: The outdoor pool is on the 35th floor next to the fitness center, with a sun deck and city views.

findings.quote: The pool is on the 35th floor, next to the fitness center, and offers a sun deck and city views.
